title: Auf und Abbau
slide_intent: Build and remove an icon deliberately so a person can follow its arrival and departure.
strategic_value: The drawn search outline can connect a familiar action to DB’s motion language.
demonstration: A dark magnifying-glass outline forms from a curved stroke, holds, and retracts on a pale field.
practical_value: Choose a stroke reveal when introducing a search symbol without moving its position.

content_islands.name: Search removal
content_islands.spec: Retract the outline to return to the empty field.
